headline: 23 detained from Tejgaon College mosque over suspected militant links
summary: Dhaka Metropolitan Police conducted a drive after receiving intelligence that members of a banned militant outfit were gathering for a secret meeting.
details: Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) detained 23 people from a mosque at Tejgaon College in the capital following Juma prayers today.
A team from the Tejgaon Police Station carried out the operation while the individuals were allegedly holding a secret meeting at the mosque.
A senior official of the Tejgaon Division stated that police had intelligence suggesting members of a banned militant outfit would gather there from various parts of the city.
Police conducted the drive based on this specific information to prevent any potential militant activity.
Authorities are currently investigating the detainees and have yet to confirm if all 23 individuals belong to the same organization.
caption:
23 people detained from a mosque in Dhaka after a suspected secret militant meeting.

Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) detained 23 people from a mosque at Tejgaon College in the capital following Juma prayers today.

A team from the Tejgaon Police Station carried out the operation while the individuals were allegedly holding a secret meeting at the mosque.

A senior official of the Tejgaon Division stated that police had intelligence suggesting members of a banned militant outfit would gather there from various parts of the city.

Police conducted the drive based on this specific information to prevent any potential militant activity.

Authorities are currently investigating the detainees and have yet to confirm if all 23 individuals belong to the same organization.

headline_marked: Two [[cocktails explode near Malibagh Railgate]] in Dhaka
headline: Two cocktails explode near Malibagh Railgate in Dhaka
summary: No casualties were reported after unidentified assailants threw cocktails from a flyover following Friday prayers.
details: Two cocktails exploded near the Malibagh Railgate in Dhaka on Friday. The blasts occurred near the Sohag Transport counter shortly after Jummah prayers.

According to Shahjahanpur Police Station OC Md. Amirul Islam, the cocktails were thrown from the flyover. Police are currently reviewing CCTV footage from the flyover entrance to identify the perpetrators.

The incident follows a series of similar attacks in the capital. On Tuesday, a cocktail exploded in front of the Supreme Court's main gate following a death sentence for seven defendants, including Awami League General Secretary Obaidul Quader.
Additionally, three cocktails exploded in succession on the Dhaka University campus on Tuesday night. Authorities are continuing their investigations into these recent blasts.
